props: Use case: stylized-concept. Original detailed production pixel art for Chronforge Echo, native960x540 RPG. Hard deliberate pixel clusters, sharp ink edges, overhead three-quarter prop perspective, upper-left cold daylight with small warm lamps. No blur, no smooth vector shapes, no characters, text, logos or watermark. Create ORBITAL REACH PROP ATLAS exactly4 columns by2 rows, eight equal square cells,2048x1024. Genuine transparent alpha background, do not draw checkerboard. Complete separate objects with16px clear gutters, ground feet near bottom. Theme: fallen space-elevator civilization in a high snowy mountain plateau; frost-white limestone, navy steel, tarnished bronze, restrained teal signal lights, red rescue pennants. TOP ROW exact order:1 tall wind-bent alpine fir with layered blue-green needles, irregular white snow shelves and exposed roots gripping pale rock;2 slender broken space-elevator anchor pylon, ivory segmented engineering tower with bronze cable drums, hanging severed thick cables and little red pennants;3 immense broken orbital docking ring on weathered white-stone supports, navy-metal braces, missing upper segment, frost and tiny cyan signal lenses;4 ruined elevated anchor-station viaduct arch, white masonry, navy girders, snow cornice and hanging cable. BOTTOM ROW:5 pale alpine boulder cluster veined with blue ice, patches of charcoal lichen;6 small welcoming anchor-keeper station cottage, steep slate roof under snow, white stone, bronze signal antenna, warm amber door and rescue supplies on porch;7 hardy red-berry alpine shrub with blue-green needles and snow-powdered grass;8 steep stratified white-rock cliff terrace with collapsed railway girder and severed elevator cables. Distinct cold industrial architecture, practical scale, rich weathering, hand-placed pixel textures. No generic flat platform beneath objects.

Native128px pixel clusters enlarged4x, no perspective, no props, no gutters or borders. TOP ROW exact order:1 blue-gray packed alpine snow with subtle grit and wind combs,2 cleaner softly sunlit ivory snow with quiet broken wind marks,3 old white-gray anchor-station stone paving with navy-metal joints, fine frost and sparse bronze fittings. BOTTOM ROW:4 dark slate gravel partly covered by crusted snow and lichen,5 shallow blue meltwater with fractured thin surface ice and subdued reflections,6 deep navy-blue alpine water with sparse quiet pale ripples. Contrast restrained enough for heroes to read; no big repeated rocks, no bright noisy sparkle, no gradients or blur.
